typography.instructions: Use Chivo for section titles, IBM Plex Sans for general text and labels, and strictly IBM Plex Mono for all numeric values, measurements (m²), and technical codes (CTE DB-SI). Keep heading sizes moderate (max text-2xl for main wizard steps, text-lg for block titles).

colors.instructions: Use high-contrast monochrome (slate/gray scales) for structure to mimic a professional software environment (CAD/Spreadsheet vibe). The orange accent (#EA580C) should be used sparingly for primary actions, active states, and important highlights. Avoid full-screen gradients. Use solid, opaque colors.

grids_and_layouts.overall_layout: Strict, dense, and compact grid hierarchy. Maximize vertical space by reducing padding.
grids_and_layouts.section_a_sectors: Use a grid-based compact card layout (e.g., grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3) or a compact horizontal list. Each sector should feel like a technical summary tile. Padding should be tight (p-3 or p-4). Use borders and a subtle gray background to differentiate from Section B.
grids_and_layouts.section_b_assignment: Implement a dense, spreadsheet-like Data Table. Use expandable rows (Shadcn Collapsible or custom table row expansion) for the 'Clasificación' details and 'Carga de Fuego'. This keeps the default view compact while allowing deep dives into specific rooms.
grids_and_layouts.visual_separation: Ensure Block A and Block B have distinct visual treatments. For example, Block A uses gray-filled compact cards with no outer border, while Block B uses a crisp, white, border-collapsed table. Include a clear, bold section divider.

spacing.strategy: Compact and Dense. Override default generous spacing to meet user's requirement for a professional/technical view.
spacing.containers: p-4 or p-6 max for main containers.
spacing.elements: gap-2 or gap-3 between inputs. p-2 for table cells.
spacing.components: Use h-8 or h-9 for inputs and buttons (Shadcn 'sm' size) to keep the UI compact.

components.cards: Cardless or completely flat with straight edges (rounded-sm or rounded-none). Use 1px solid borders.
components.tables: Dense styling. border-collapse. text-sm. Table headers should be uppercase, tracking-wider, text-xs, text-muted.
components.inputs: Shadcn UI inputs, customized to h-8, rounded-sm, subtle border.
components.expandable_rows: Use Shadcn `Collapsible` or custom state-based rendering for table rows. The expanded area should have a slightly different background (e.g., bg-slate-50) and an inner border to show it belongs to the parent row.
components.badges: Use small, square badges for Status or Classification (e.g., 'Normal', 'LRE', 'Escalera').

motion.interactions: Minimal and snappy. 150ms transitions for hover states. Expand/collapse animations should be fast (200ms) to not slow down the technical user.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text against gray backgrounds meets at least 4.5:1 ratio. Orange accent on white must be readable.
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='sector-card-1', data-testid='room-expand-button-2').

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize a dense, technical aesthetic (spreadsheet or IDE-like) over marketing-style spacing.
Implement Block A (Sectores) as a compact grid of summary tiles (bg-slate-50, border-slate-200, p-3).
Implement Block B (Asignación) as a dense table where each row represents a room. Hide the 'Carga de fuego' and 'Clasificación' details inside an expandable/collapsible row.
Use 'rounded-sm' globally to maintain the existing NormaLab brand.
Ensure the header or sticky elements NEVER have a transparent background. Use solid colors.
Use IBM Plex Mono for all numeric fields (m², factors, dimensions).
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, switches, and inputs.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use transparent backgrounds for headers, overlays, or dropdowns. Ensure text readability.
Avoid generic centered layouts for dense data forms. Left-align text, right-align numbers.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but keep surfaces flat (no soft shadows, use borders).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container in CSS.
Use modern button styles relevant to the app style (compact, technical).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Include `data-testid` attribute for all interactive elements.
